rules.stage_a: Max throughput with offer p99 <= 1.05x the original profile; tie: lower p99, buffer, QD.
rules.stage_b: Per-pattern PF budget maximizing geometric throughput across accuracy 1/.75/.5; all ratios >= .98 and p99 ratios <= 1.05. Zero budget is included.
rules.stage_c: Max throughput among CA head OFF/ON x Data head OFF/ON, p99 <= 1.05x the stage-B baseline. Tie prefers the baseline, then simpler policy.
rules.checks: Freeze candidate before long traces, seeds, remap, port counts, B patterns and 64Plane. Report paired regressions; do not retune on checks.

geometry: 4 channels; planes is per channel; strict per-port in-order
occupancy: Exact time integral over first Host offer to last Host return; ready includes returning payload and unused PF.
long_diagnostics: Offline next-page inspection after selection; not used for scheduling. Final in-flight CA choices may exceed classified tr_long by up to channels.
